data.Name: GRAND — Decision Gate 2 DG2 Concept Select
data.Description: DG2 concept selection for the Grane Northern Area Development (GRAND) project. The GRAND area comprises F-Structure and D-Structure discoveries in Palaeocene Heimdal Formation sands on the NW flank of Utsira High, Viking Graben. 300 geo-realisations were run to quantify STOIIP uncertainty across three structures (F, D, D-North) and three facies groups (Heimdal, Mapped Injectites, Unmapped Injectites). DG2 recommends subsea tie-back to Grane with 4×6-slot templates, 23 wells (including 2 multilateral), targeting June 2023 start-up.
data.DecisionSummary: Approve subsea tie-back development to Grane platform. Four 6-slot templates (24 slots), 23 wells plus 2 multilateral. Reference case STOIIP 118.7 MSm³ (P90 70.7, P10 158.7). Start-up target June 2023.

Parameters.Title: Volumes evidence
Parameters.Selection: Aggregated PRMS statistics used for the DG2 decision

Parameters.Title: Petroleum Technology Report (DG2)
Parameters.Selection: PM398-DD-200-001 Rev 01 Final — 548 pages covering seismic, petrophysics, geomodelling, dynamic simulation

Alternatives.Name: Alt-A: Subsea tie-back to Grane (4×6-slot templates)
Alternatives.Rationale: Highest NPV; leverages existing Grane infrastructure for lift gas and water handling. 23 wells + 2 multilateral; start-up heater and LP gas debottlenecking on Grane required. Provisions for future expansion with additional templates or subsea pump.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-B: Standalone FPSO
Alternatives.Rationale: Higher CAPEX and schedule risk per SRA and CRA. Provides independence from Grane but does not justify the cost premium given the reference-case volumes.

Alternatives.Name: Alt-C: Reduced scope — F-Structure only
Alternatives.Rationale: Lower initial investment but forgoes 55% of the reference STOIIP (D-Structure = 64.3 MSm³ REF). May be revisited if D-Structure volumes prove lower than P90 after DG3 appraisal.

DevelopmentConcept.Summary: Subsea development with 4×6-slot templates (24 slots), tie-back to Grane platform. Two flowlines (16" and 14") plus 8" gas lift line. Distance to Grane ~10-12 km. Water depth 128–130 m.

KeyUncertainties.Factor: Seismic time interpretation and depth conversion
KeyUncertainties.Description: Top reservoir interpretation is uncertain due to limitations in seismic resolution. Depth conversion adds to total depth uncertainty of the top reservoir surface. New 4D baseline acquisition planned for 2020.
Thin and heavy oil zone directly above an active aquifer. Recovery may be low due to high oil viscosity and thin oil column thickness. ICD/AICD and subsea pumps under evaluation.

Sand remobilisation and injection processes have generated a complex network of sand dykes and sills. Predicting their location and volumetric potential is highly uncertain. Mapped injectites contribute 22.1 MSm³ (REF) but unmapped injectites add 14.9 MSm³ with high uncertainty.
Wells target areas with >10 m oil column in Heimdal and >12 m in mapped injectites. Higher placement towards top Heimdal and longer reservoir sections could improve recovery.

UncertaintySummary.Basis: PRMS; probabilistic FMU using 300 geo-realisations (3 selected: Real 1 = REF, Real 88 = P90, Real 58 = P10). Static in-place volumes from DG2 geomodels.
UncertaintySummary.Note: Volumes from Table 11-23 of PM398-DD-200-001 Rev 01. Bo and GOR differentiated by structure.
UncertaintySummary.MethodologyReference: FMU Level 2 static uncertainty workflow (GRAND DG2 geomodel)
